clips.send: Summary: translations, reflections and rotations are rigid motions, so their images are congruent. A dilation multiplies coordinates by k , keeping the shape but changing the size, so its image is similar.

clips.send: Slides, flips and turns are rigid motions: lengths and angles never change. Slide each image back with the opposite move and it lands exactly on ABC . Figures that match like this are congruent: triangle A'B'C' is congruent to triangle ABC .

clips.send: Translation (a slide): every point moves 6 left and 4 down. Watch the coordinates of A change: subtract 6 from x and 4 from y . Rule: (x, y) to (x minus 6, y minus 4) .

clips.send: 例题：怎样把 三角形 ABC 变到粉色三角形上？粉色三角形是“倒过来”的，所以先关于 x 轴翻折： (x, y) to (x, 负y) ；再向左平移 6: (x, y) to (x 减 6, y) 。合起来： (x, y) to (x 减 6, 负y) 。只用了刚体变换，所以两个三角形全等。
clips.text: 例题：怎样把 triangle ABC 变到粉色三角形上？粉色三角形是“倒过来”的，所以先关于 x 轴翻折：(x, y) to (x, -y)；再向左平移 6:(x, y) to (x - 6, y)。合起来：(x, y) to (x - 6, -y)。只用了刚体变换，所以两个三角形全等。

clips.send: 位似变换会改变大小。以原点为位似中心、比例 k 等于 1.5 时，每个点沿着从原点出发的射线移动，直到距离变成原来的 1.5 倍： (x, y) to (1.5x, 1.5y) 。如果 k 等于 2分之1 ，图形就缩小。
